en: The image shows an old postcard featuring an ornate stone bridge with decorative lamp posts and balustrades. There are several people on the bridge, as well as a horse-drawn carriage and an early tram. In the background stands a large, classical-style building. The postcard has handwritten text near the bottom and printed text identifying the location as Göteborg (Gothenburg), with the name 'Kungsparksbron' visible, indicating the bridge depicted.
